title: Sign of a Coordinate Sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a subset of the coordinates $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and let $x$ assign an element of $\\mathbb{F}_2$ to each coordinate. The sign encoding of the sum in $\\mathbb{F}_2$ of the coordinates of $x$ in $S$ equals the product of their sign encodings.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$
$x$ assigns an element of $\\mathbb{F}_2$ to each coordinate
